pages.title: Minion Kevin Secretly Following Young Gru Into the Criminal Records Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Minion Kevin secretly following young Gru into the Criminal Records shop, peeking through the doorway as Gru approaches bins of records. Kevin's raised hands and Gru's long scarf frame the entrance, while hanging lamps, record sleeves, and floor tiles add interior details.

pages.title: Minion Kevin Adjusting a Television Antenna to Find the Villain-con Broadcast Coloring Page
pages.description: Minion Kevin adjusts a television antenna to find the Villain-con broadcast in this printable coloring page, holding one aerial above a screen showing a stage and audience. The television's knobs, speaker slots, and tapered legs add small sections beside Kevin's broad overalls and round goggles on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Minion Kevin Riding a Royal Corgi with a Croquet Mallet Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Minion Kevin riding a royal corgi with a croquet mallet raised between his hands, beside a ball on the grass. The corgi wears a decorated collar with a central medallion. Garden urns, clipped shrubs, and a balustrade provide smaller background details.

pages.title: Minion Kevin Practicing Board Breaking with Master Chow Coloring Page
pages.description: Minion Kevin practices board breaking with Master Chow in this printable coloring page, extending his hand through a split board as his instructor holds both halves. Their tied martial arts uniforms provide broad coloring areas, while broken wood edges, floor tiles, and bundled practice sticks add fine details.

pages.title: Minion Kevin Transformed Into a Rabbit Fighting the Tiger Svengeance Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Minion Kevin transformed into a rabbit fighting the tiger Svengeance, facing the striped animal with raised paws and long ears. The tiger leans forward with open jaws and extended claws. Small ground stones contrast with the larger body shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Minion Kevin Disguised as a Glamorous Mother Picking Young Gru Up From School Coloring Page
pages.description: Minion Kevin disguises himself as a glamorous mother picking young Gru up from school in this printable coloring page, wearing a dress, necklace, and curled hairstyle. Gru holds his backpack straps beside the school gates. The handbag, earrings, scarf stripes, and gate finials supply smaller areas to color.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Pointing In Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Minion Kevin pointing across a workshop, with one hand on his hip beside a bench holding gears and a small machine. His large goggles and overall pocket stand out against the simple background. Gear teeth, window panes, and tool shapes add compact coloring sections.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Watching In Adventure Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Minion Kevin watches an adventure area in this printable coloring page, standing between tall flowers below rocky cliffs, palm trees, and a smoking volcano beyond a winding river. His rounded body provides an open central area, while petals, palm fronds, and layered landscape contours add smaller sections around him.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Looking Around In Challenge Area Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kevin looking around a challenge area, standing on a platform among curved ramps, block towers, and a suspended rope bridge in the background. A large gear appears beside the walkway. Broad concrete shapes contrast with the smaller overall straps and goggle outlines.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Reaching On Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: Kevin reaches upward on a beach in this printable coloring page, raising both hands and lifting one foot beside a leaning palm tree near the sea. A round sun hangs above the shoreline. The coloring sheet includes broad sand areas, gentle wave lines, rocks, and small overall details.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Walking By Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kevin walking beside a lake, stepping past grass tufts and tall reeds with distant hills and rounded clouds across the water. His bent arm and lifted shoe give the pose movement. Open sky and lake areas balance the smaller overall pockets and reed stems.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Running In Open Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Kevin runs across an open field in this printable coloring page, wearing a rounded helmet while lifting one fist and stretching a boot forward above scattered grass tufts. Rolling hills and clouds keep the background simple. Helmet panels, overall straps, and shoe soles provide smaller sections to color.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Waving In Treasure Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Minion Kevin waving inside a treasure room, smiling beside an open chest overflowing with coins and necklaces beneath a decorated stone arch. Stacked bars and scattered jewels surround his boots. The coloring sheet mixes large clothing areas with small circular coins and torch flames.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Standing Calmly In Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Minion Kevin stands calmly in a garden in this printable coloring page, surrounded by tall flowers, spotted mushrooms, and a winding stepping-stone path beside a picket fence. Broad petals and overall panels offer open coloring spaces, while small mushroom spots, fence nails, and goggle rings provide finer details.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Exploring On Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Minion Kevin exploring a hill with two companions, holding a magnifying glass beside a winding path under large rounded clouds in the sky. A lone tree rises beyond the slope. The coloring sheet pairs broad landscape shapes with smaller goggles, gloves, and overall emblems.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Resting In Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Kevin rests on a sloping valley hillside in this printable coloring page, leaning sideways with closed eyes beneath a round sun and clouds above distant ridges. Sparse trees line the rolling landscape. His tilted goggles and overall emblem provide smaller sections within the broad, open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Jumping On Snowy Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page captures Kevin jumping on a snowy hill with both arms raised and boots lifted between rows of snow-covered evergreen trees behind him. Rounded clouds frame the airborne pose. Large snow banks and open sky balance the smaller goggle rims and overall straps.

pages.title: Minions Kevin Posing in Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: Kevin poses in a desert in this printable coloring page, waving one gloved hand while resting the other beside his overalls beneath a sun with short rays. Cacti, pointed plants, and scattered rocks surround him. Curving dunes provide broad areas alongside the smaller pockets and hair strands.
